agentsvc-skills-agentsvc.description: Call one of 127 pay-per-call APIs from agentsvc.io when a task needs something you cannot do yourself, such as reading a web page, a screenshot, speech to text, OCR, email verification, a token or wallet check, sanctions screening, company lookup, exchange rates, weather, news or satellite images. Use when the user asks for live or external data or a conversion you have no tool for. Search the catalog for free, then call the endpoint with a credit token, an x402 wallet or the Zero CLI. Prices from $0.0015 per call, failed calls are never charged.

agentsvc-skills-read-documents.description: Get the text out of documents your agent cannot read itself, PDFs, scans and photos (OCR), Word, ODT, EPUB and RTF files, and turn invoices into structured JSON (number, dates, seller, buyer, VAT ID, line items, totals; also XRechnung and ZUGFeRD). Use when the user hands you a file or link and you need its text or fields. agentsvc.io, from $0.0055 per document, no account, failed calls are not charged.

agentsvc-skills-token-safety-check.description: Check a crypto token for honeypot, rug pull and scam risk before buying, swapping or accepting it, on Base, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Polygon, Avalanche, Optimism or Solana. Returns a risk grade A to F with reasons (sell tax, mint and freeze authority, owner powers, liquidity, holder concentration). Use before any trade or when a user asks whether a token is safe. agentsvc.io, from $0.004 per check, no account.

agentsvc-skills-transcribe-audio.description: Transcribe audio to text (speech to text) with timestamps, in about 100 languages with automatic language detection. Use when the user gives you a voice note, meeting recording, podcast, interview or call recording (mp3, m4a, wav, ogg, webm, flac, mp4) and wants the text, a summary, quotes or subtitles. Runs Whisper on agentsvc.io, $0.01 per file of up to 10 minutes, no account, failed calls are not charged.

agentsvc-skills-verify-email.description: Check whether an email address really exists before sending outreach, importing a lead list or accepting a sign-up. Asks the receiving mail server (SMTP check, no email is sent) on top of syntax, MX, disposable and role-address checks, and returns deliverable, undeliverable, catch_all, risky or unknown. agentsvc.io, $0.002 per address, no account.

agentsvc-skills-web-to-markdown.description: Read web pages as clean, LLM-ready Markdown, one URL, up to 20 URLs in one call, or a whole site section, plus real-browser screenshots. Use when the user wants you to read, summarize, compare or extract from web pages and your own fetch fails, returns raw HTML, is blocked, or the page needs JavaScript. agentsvc.io, from $0.0015 per page, no account, failed pages are not charged.
